events.title: Demo V 0.1.5 Bug fix
events.summary: Hello everyone! In the latest update, we've fixed the following bugs:Fixed a bug where the Shop couldn't be opened from the world map.Fixed a bug where opening the Shop from the Team Setup screen in the last two levels would freeze the game.Fixed a bug where movement commands could be issued incorrectly on the world map.

events.title: Demo V 0.1.4 Bug fix
events.summary: Hello everyone! In the latest update, we've fixed the following bugs:Adjusted AI behavior — the AI now attacks more aggressively.Fixed a bug where the panoramic camera showed a black screen or missing floor.Fixed a bug where effects were missing on the cat shield-selection page.

events.title: Demo V 0.1.3 bug fix
events.summary: Hello everyone! In the latest update, we've fixed the following bugs:Optimized Latte's animations.Fixed a bug with incorrect Pathway unlocks.Fine-tuned AI behavior on Hard and Expert.

events.title: Demo V 0.1.2 Bug fix
events.summary: Hello everyone! In the latest update, we've fixed the following bugs:Fixed a bug where eye adjustments for Pudding and Box Cat didn't work.Fixed a bug where all of Pudding's head bow accessories would disappear.Fixed a bug where Latte wouldn't load accessories on the level-select map.Fixed a bug with Benben's skin display.Fixed the lighting on all bonus skins.Fixed a bug where grass disappeared in some level fields.

events.title: Our Demo Is Finally Here! Launching October 19
events.summary: Hello everyone! 🐈🐈🐈 We're back!It's been a while since our last playtest. We've been heads-down working on a lot of changes, and we're finally ready to share some great news:The Paw and Plot Demo will launch at 8:00 PM Beijing Time on October 19! (13:00 London / 8:00 AM ET / 5:00 AM PT) it's a real Demo. events.title: Paw and Plot beta play test start on Jan 30!
events.summary: Hello Gamers! 🐈🐈🐈 Welcome to this playtest!We'll launch the open beta test with data wipes on January 30th at 10 AM GMT Time!
